## [8.0.0] - 2026-01-20

### Changed
- **Breaking:** frame layout now uses variable-width driver ids. Streams
  produced by 7.x are not readable by 8.x collectors and vice versa.
- Collectors on 8.x advertise protocol `8.x` in the handshake. SDK builds
  on the 7.x line refuse to go active against them, by design.
